assertion.text: Erdős Problem #850: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Can there exist two distinct integers $x$ and $y$ such that $x,y$ have the same prime factors, $x+1,y+1$ have the same prime factors, and $x+2,y+2$ also have the same prime factors? Prize: no. OEIS: A343101. Tags: number theory, primes.
